To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the adjacent channel interference from IMT-advanced to broadcasting system is not significant and the interference coordination is feasible.

the adjacent channel interference from the International mobile telecommunication-advanced system at 698 to 806 MHz to the television broadcasting system below 700 MHz can be mitigated by the proposed spectrum plan.
adjacent channel interference from IMT-A system to broadcasting system in China can be controlled within the limit specified by ITU-R SM. 2010.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the interference between IMT-A system and broadcasting system in the same band and it can also be used as a reference to other systems.
the interference analysis of adjacent channels in the IMT-A and broadcasting systems, which is helpful for the spectrum plan in China and other countries.
the coexistence of the IMT-A and the broadcasting systems in adjacent channels.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, for coexistence of IMT-A system and the broadcasting system in adjacent channels, the adjacent channel interference can be controlled below the threshold level of the broadcasting system.
the interference from the IMT-A system to broadcasting service is negligible and the interference from the broadcasting system to IMT-A system is not harmful.
the interference from IMT-A to broadcasting service is acceptable in China.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the interference level is not very serious and the adjacent channel interference is acceptable.

the interference from IMT-A to broadcasting system in China could be controlled within the acceptable limits if reasonable measures are applied in the network plan, spectrum plan and interference management.
the interference from IMT-A system to broadcasting system is not severe.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the adjacent channel interference from IMT-A system is acceptable in China.
the interference from the IMT-A system to the broadcasting system is not serious and it can be controlled within the acceptable range by the appropriate measures in the network plan.

, for the interference from the IMT-A system to the broadcasting system in China, the maximum allowable power for the IMT-A base station can be calculated by the following equation: PIMT ≤ 0.2Pb + PIMT0 + 10 log10(1.6×10-4), where Pb is the power of the broadcasting station, and PIMT0 is the minimum allowable power for IMT-A base stations.
